 Technical Inspection Form for Distributors
Next review date:
Introduction
This document sets out the technical inspection form for major maintenance works P2, which are carried out every two years on medium voltage distributors as indicated above by the code Y2, and the form was prepared, reviewed and approved by the MPIS coordinators of all electricity distribution companies.
This maintenance is carried out to ensure the quality of completion of the major maintenance works on the distributor components.
Safety Precautions
Issue an approved work order; maintenance personnel must carry the occupational safety and health category card. | 
Fence off the work location and post warning signs. | 
Wear occupational safety and health equipment. | 
Ensure the availability of sound tools, instruments and equipment and the spare parts used in maintenance. | 
Ensure absence of voltage from the supply source using the voltage indicator on the part to be worked on. | 
Ensure the cable disconnect switches are opened and isolated from all their sources. | 
Ensure portable earthing is applied to the equipment to be worked on. | 
Ensure the DC supply of the protection devices is disconnected. | 
Ensure the cells are numbered and named from the front and back. | 
Ensure the occupational safety and health and protection officials are present at the site. | 
Tools, Instruments and Equipment Used
Emergency lighting machine.
Complete tool bag (set of sockets, set of screwdrivers, set of Allen keys, set of open-end spanners, etc.).
Occupational safety and health equipment such as safety helmet, safety shoes, gloves, goggles, cotton overalls with sleeves, etc.
Blower, portable earth, cleaning brushes and soft clean cloth pieces.
Suitable electrical grease, lubricating oil, paint material, paint primer.
Numbering machine, first aid bag.

Earth resistance measuring device, avometer, tested voltage indicator, hydrometer.

Fire extinguisher and sensor hose, insulating hoses for the phases.
Numbering machine, first aid bag.

Essential items to be verified during the major maintenance works on the distributors.
Open a work order showing the official and the workers and the availability of the occupational safety and health category card for each of them. | 
Define the work location, fence it off and post warning signs. | 
Provide occupational safety and health equipment and wear it, such as the helmet, safety shoes, face mask, eye goggles, and the cotton overalls with sleeves, and use the insulating platform when carrying out tests. | 
Provide sound tools, instruments and equipment and the spare parts used in maintenance. | 
Periodic maintenance of the cells. | 
Cleanliness of the distributor components. | 
Quality of the connections of the cell control circuits. | 
Switching off and on times of the circuit breakers. | 
Test the operation of the circuit breaker spring charging motor. | 
Test the performance of the mechanical auxiliary contact set of the circuit breaker. | 
Test the performance of the relay control circuit with the circuit breaker in the cell in the test position. | 
Test the switching off and on coils (Blocking coil) inside the circuit breaker. | 
Re-tighten the current transformer wires and the control wires inside the cell in the distributors. | 
Cleanliness of the cell control room and checking the control connections in the cell control room. | 
All equipment in the control room works in a technically sound manner, including (switches - miniature - contactors - timer - relays). | 
Check the soundness of the indicator lamps. | 
For current transformers, the following must be followed: | 
Secure the switching off of the cell and take it over from the control with earthing applied to it. | 
Check the circuits of the current transformers and the cell and re-tighten them. | 
Inject the rated current of the transformer and read the secondary current on the measuring and protection devices according to the transformation ratio. | 
After the tests are completed and the voltage is released: | 
The AC voltage must be measured on the directional protection devices. |
